paragraphs.text: One Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Commander (also referred to as TMNT Commander ) deck was released together with the main Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles set on March 6, 2026.

The TMNT Commander deck features one face Commander and multiple cards with the mechanic Partner—Character select , allowing you to have a second Commander in play. Combining individual strengths to create a dream team is a core part of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles. Each Partner card highlights those strengths and adds a different flair to your path to victory. The face commander, Leonardo, the Balance , has a color identity . His Partner—Character select allows for up to one of the other five cards in the deck with Partner—Character select to be chosen as a second commander. The backup commander is Heroes in a Half Shell .
Thematically the deck "has a video game theme." Mechanically it is based on +1/+1 counters and Mutagen tokens.
1 ready-to-play 100-card Commander deck 1 borderless traditional foil face commander 5 borderless traditional foil featured commanders 94 non-foil cards
10 double-sided tokens or punch-out counter cards

TMC #83-90 are Showcase "Arcade" versions of Commander cards that show up in Collector Boosters . Additional cards using the TMC expansion code can be found in the Turtle Team-Up product (TMC #098-130) and the Pizza Bundle (TMC #131-135).
A deck centered around the four turtles and Splinter.
1 April O'Neil, Live on the Scene
The 43 new cards in the deck are:
April O'Neil, Live on the Scene
This deck includes five cards that have be reskinned to fit the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles theme:
Aggro Amalgam is a skinned version of Voracious Hydra .
Heralds of the Shredder is a skinned version of Vigor .
Humongous Fungus is a skinned version of Corpsejack Menace .
Marauding Mutagen is a skinned version of Acidic Slime .
Slash Clone is a skinned version of Steelbane Hydra .
